contracts.signal: Novo Nordisk and Anthropic announced a collaboration in which Novo will use Anthropic models and Claude Science to advance scientific reasoning in R&D and agentic software engineering. The companies will jointly address drug discovery challenges identified by Novo's scientists and computational teams; as an initial aim Novo will test Claude Science for specific R&D workflows, and it will also use Anthropic's frontier models to strengthen AI-driven software development. CEO Mike Doustdar said it builds on Novo's AI initiatives with other technology partners toward its ambition to become 'the world's most AI-driven healthcare company'.
